车上的几十个控制器共用一根线说话。从\"每一拍线上有一位\"开始，亲手搭出听懂它: The dozens of controllers in a car talk over one shared line. Starting from “one bit on the line each tick”, build a probe that understands them, and grow it step by step into a tester that reads fault codes and reflashes software.
插上总线，上面在说什么？: Plugged into the bus: what is being said on it?
车上几十个控制器共用的一对线。这里讲的是 CAN 总线（ISO 11898-1）: The pair of wires the dozens of controllers in a car share. The one here is the CAN bus (ISO 11898-1): at any moment there is one bit on the line, every controller sees it, and any of them can speak.
真实的总线上是两根线之间的电压差；游戏从\"每一拍线上有一位\"讲起，不讲电压、: On a real bus the bit is a voltage difference between two wires; the game starts from “one bit on the line each tick”, without voltages, terminating resistors or bit timing.
总线上的 0。只要有一个控制器说显性，整根线就是显性：它压过隐性。: A 0 on the bus. If any one controller says dominant, the whole line is dominant: it wins over recessive.
总线上的 1。只有所有控制器都说隐性（或者都不说话）时，线才是隐性。没人说话的总: A 1 on the bus. The line is recessive only when every controller says recessive (or none says anything). A bus nobody is talking on stays recessive.
探针每一拍把板从头跑一遍。寄存卡是板上唯一能跨过一拍的东西：这一拍存进去的值，下: The probe runs the board afresh each tick. A register is the one thing on it that lasts from one tick to the next: what is kept in it this tick can be read on the next.
一帧的第一位，一位显性。只有在总线连着安静了至少 11 位之后，控制器才能开口，: The first bit of a frame, one dominant bit. A controller may only start talking once the bus has been quiet for at least 11 bits, so the first dominant bit after that quiet is a start of frame.
帧起始后面的 11 位，高位在前。它说的是这条消息是什么（车速、门开没开……），: The 11 bits after the start of frame, highest first. It says what the message is (the speed, whether a door is open…), not who sent it; each message is sent by one controller.
真实的 CAN 还有 29 位的扩展标识符，游戏只用 11 位的。: Real CAN also has 29-bit extended identifiers; the game uses the 11-bit ones only.
车上的控制器共用一根<wiki-ref to=\"bus\"></wiki-re: The controllers in a car share one <wiki-ref to="bus"></wiki-ref>. In this chapter you build a probe that only listens: plug it into the bus and work out what is being said on it.
探针每一拍跑一遍你的板。板左边的总线元件给出这一拍线上的那一位：0 是<wiki: The probe runs your board once a tick. The bus part on its left gives this tick’s bit on the line: 0 is <wiki-ref to="dominant"></wiki-ref>, 1 is <wiki-ref to="recessive"></wiki-ref>. Running is time: the waveform below moves on one tick a cell.
板每一拍从头跑一遍，只看得到这一拍。没人说话时线一直是隐性；一帧开始，线上才有了: The board runs afresh each tick and sees only that tick. With nobody talking the line stays recessive; once a frame starts, dominant bits appear.
每一拍，把总线上的那一位原样交出去。: Every tick, give out the bit on the bus as it is.
把左边的总线元件接到右边的输出上。: Wire the bus part on the left into the output on the right.
板每一拍从头跑，上一拍的东西它一样也记不住。可总线上的一位只有和前后连起来看才有: The board starts afresh each tick and remembers nothing of the last one. Yet a bit on the bus only means something next to the bits around it.
探针多了一种能力：<wiki-ref to=\"register\"></wik: The probe gains one ability: <wiki-ref to="register"></wiki-ref>s. <part-ref to="part:keep"></part-ref> stores the value wired into it this tick, and <part-ref to="part:reg"></part-ref> reads it back on the next one; two parts with the same name are the same register. The reading one has a start value: what it reads before anything is kept.
寄存卡把一拍和下一拍连了起来：从现在起，板能记事了。: A register ties one tick to the next: from now on the board can remember.
每一拍交出总线上一拍的那一位；第一拍交出 1。: Every tick, give out the bit the bus had the tick before; 1 on the first tick.
这一拍的总线存起来，下一拍读出来交出去。: Keep the bus this tick, and give out what you read next tick.
能记住上一拍以后，就能看出线什么时候变了。新元件<part-ref to=\"p: Remembering the last tick, the board can tell when the line changes. A new part, <part-ref to="part:compare"></part-ref>: yes when its two values are equal, no when they are not; it has a second form, Less than.
一张寄存卡加一个比较，板就看得出线在哪一拍变了。: A register and a comparison, and the board can see the tick the line changes.
每一拍回答：总线这一拍的位和上一拍一样吗？第一拍拿它和 1 比。: Every tick, answer: is the bit on the bus the same as the tick before? On the first tick, compare it with 1.
要知道一位落在一帧的哪里，得会数。寄存卡记得住一个数，还缺一样把它往上加的东西。: To know where a bit falls in a frame, the board has to count. A register can hold a number; what is missing is something to add to it.
新元件<part-ref to=\"part:arith\"></part-re: A new part, <part-ref to="part:arith"></part-ref>: its form Add one gives its input plus 1, and Add gives the sum of its two inputs.
读出、加一、存回去：一个绕过寄存卡的小圈，每拍转一次，就是计数。: Read, add one, keep it: a small loop through a register, once round each tick, is a count.
每一拍交出这是第几拍：第一拍是 0。: Every tick, give out which tick this is: the first is 0.
探针刚插上时不知道总线正说到哪里，要先等一阵。等多久是一个定好的数，板上还没有能: A probe just plugged in does not know where the bus is in what it is saying, so it waits a while first. How long is a fixed number, and the board has no part yet that holds a number.
新元件<part-ref to=\"part:const\"></part-re: A new part, <part-ref to="part:const"></part-ref>: always gives the number it is set to.
计数加上一个比较，就是\"等到第几拍\"。: A count and a comparison make “wait until tick so-and-so”.
从第 11 拍（从 0 数起）开始一直回答「是」，在那之前回答「否」。: Answer yes from tick 11 on (counting from 0), and no before it.
数拍只会一直往上数。要数\"连着多少拍\"，得在断的那一拍把数清零：板要能在两个: Counting ticks only goes up. To count “how many in a row”, the count has to go back to zero on the tick the run breaks: the board has to pick one of two values.
新元件<part-ref to=\"part:select\"></part-r: A new part, <part-ref to="part:select"></part-ref>: when its condition is yes or 1 it gives its Yes input, when it is no or 0 its No input; an input left open reads 「—」.
交出「接着数」在这一拍之前连着是 1 的拍数；「接着数」为 0 的那一拍过后从: Gives how many ticks in a row Go on was 1 before this tick; after a tick where Go on is 0 it counts from 0 again. Each counter has registers of its own.
这块板现在是一个元件了，板上放几块，就各数各的。: This board is now a part, and several of them on one board each keep their own count.
每一拍交出「接着数」在这一拍之前连着是 1 的拍数；它一是 0，就从 0 重数。: Every tick, give out how many ticks in a row Go on was 1 before this one; once it is 0, start again from 0.
没人说话时总线一直是隐性。一个控制器开口，先说一位显性：这一位叫<wiki-re: With nobody talking the bus stays recessive. A controller that starts talking first says one dominant bit: the <wiki-ref to="sof"></wiki-ref>.
可一帧里面到处都有显性。只有在总线确实安静过一阵以后的那个显性，才是一帧的开头。: Yet a frame is full of dominant bits. Only the dominant bit after the bus has really been quiet for a while is where a frame begins.
一帧的最后是 11 位隐性：应答界定位、7 位帧结束、3 位帧间间隔。所以两帧紧: A frame ends with 11 recessive bits: the ACK delimiter, 7 bits of end of frame and 3 of intermission. So even with frames back to back, this rule still finds the next one.
总线连着至少 11 拍隐性之后的第一个显性，回答「是」；其余每一拍回答「否」。: Answer yes on the first dominant bit after at least 11 recessive ones in a row, and no on every other tick.
数出这一拍之前隐性连着多长。: Count how long the recessive run before this tick is.
显性是 0，可以拿它和常数 0 比。: Dominant is 0, and can be compared with a constant 0.
总线上的数是一位一位到的：说话的控制器先说最高位。探针要把它们攒回一个数。: Numbers come over the bus a bit at a time, the highest bit first. The probe has to gather them back into a number.
攒下的数后面多接一位，它在二进制里整体左移了一格，再加上新来的那一位。: Putting one more bit after the number gathered so far shifts it one place left in binary, then adds the new bit.
「接着攒」为 1 时，把「位」接到攒下的数末尾，交出新的数；为 0 时交出 0: When Go on is 1, puts Bit at the end of the number gathered and gives the new number; when it is 0, gives 0 and empties. Each one has registers of its own.
一个数加上自己，就是左移一格；再加上新的一位，就接上了。: A number added to itself is shifted one place left; add the new bit and it is on the end.
「接着攒」为 1 的每一拍，把「位」接到已经攒下的数的末尾（先来的位在高位），交: On every tick Go on is 1, put Bit at the end of the number gathered so far (the first bit highest) and give out the number; on a tick it is 0, give out 0 and start over.
认得出一帧从哪开始，也会把位攒成数，探针就能读出第一样东西：这一帧是哪条消息。每: Knowing where a frame starts and how to gather bits into a number, the probe can read the first thing: which message this frame is. Every frame begins with an 11-bit <wiki-ref to="identifier"></wiki-ref>, which says what the message is and how urgent.
一个帧起始只亮一拍，可之后的 11 拍都要知道\"我在一帧里面\"。: A start of frame lights for one tick, yet the 11 ticks after it all need to know “I am inside a frame”.
两块计数器各数各的：一块数总线安静了多久，一块数进帧以后过了几拍。: The two counters count on their own: one how long the bus was quiet, one how many ticks since the frame began.
帧起始后面的 11 位是这一帧的标识符。在它最后一位到达的那一拍交出标识符，其余: The 11 bits after the start of frame are the frame’s identifier. Give it out on the tick its last bit arrives, and 「—」 on every other tick.
帧起始那一拍，在寄存卡里记下\"进帧了\"，之后一直记着。: On the start of frame, keep “in a frame” in a register, and keep it there.
进帧以后的拍数，用一块<part-ref to=\"counter\"></pa: Count the ticks since then with a <part-ref to="counter"></part-ref>.
刚才读标识符时，试的是开头没有填充位的帧。换一条消息，连续相同的位之间会多出一位: The identifiers read so far had no stuff bits at the start. Other messages contain an extra bit: after five equal bits in a row, the sender inserts one opposite bit.
接收方要跳过填充位。注意，填充位本身也算线上连续位的第一位；后面若再有四位与它相: The receiver skips the stuff bit. The stuff bit itself starts the next run on the line; if four more bits match it, the following bit is stuffed too.
数的是线上连续的位，包括被跳过的填充位。: The run is counted on the line, including the stuff bit that was skipped.
记住上一拍的位和连着相同的位数。: Remember the previous bit and the length of its run.
上一拍刚数到五，这一拍就是填充位；仍要把它记作新的一段的第一位。: If the run reached five on the previous tick, this tick is stuffed; still count it as the first bit of the next run.
现在用搭好的元件试一段更容易出错的位串：填充位后面紧跟四个与它相同的位。: Try the part on a trickier stream: four bits equal to a stuff bit follow it.
两次填充可以只隔四个原始位，因为第一次的填充位也参与计数。: Two stuff bits can be separated by just four original bits, because the first stuff bit also counts.
去除位串中的填充位，并把剩下的位交出来；填充位的那一拍交出「—」。: Remove the stuff bits and give out the remaining bits; give 「—」 on each stuff-bit tick.
把去除填充位后的位依次攒成一个数，每拍交出当前的数。填充位那一拍保持原数；开始时: Gather the bits after removing stuff bits into a number, and give the current number each tick. Keep it unchanged on a stuff-bit tick; start at zero.
「有效」为否时保留寄存卡里的数；为是时将它左移一位并加上新位。: When Valid is no, keep the register’s number; when yes, shift it left and add the new bit.
现在可以从真实的帧里读下一样东西：数据长度。标准格式的数据帧从帧起始开始，接着是: Now read another field in a real frame: its data length. A standard-format data frame begins with start of frame, then an 11-bit identifier, RTR, IDE and a reserved bit, followed by four data-length bits.
这一关从帧起始的第一拍开始，只读一帧。数位置时只数原始位；填充位占了一拍，却不属: This level starts on the first tick of the frame and reads one frame. Count positions in original bits only; a stuff bit occupies a tick but belongs to no field.
读出这帧的四位数据长度，在最后一位原始长度位到达时交出它；其他拍交出「—」。第一: Read the four-bit data length and give it on the tick its last original bit arrives; give 「—」 on all other ticks. The first tick is start of frame, at position zero.
先用去除填充位元件；只有「有效」为是的拍才让位置加一。: Remove stuff bits first; advance the position only on ticks where Valid is yes.
长度字段的位置是 15 至 18。用寄存卡在这四位到达时攒数，最后一位到达时交出: The length occupies positions 15 to 18. Use a register to gather those four bits and give the result on the last bit.
位置是原始位的位置，时间则是线上经过的拍数；一旦有填充，这两个数就不同。: Position counts original bits, while time counts ticks on the line. Once stuffing occurs, the two differ.
一帧能带零到八个字节。长度字段决定数据到哪里结束；每八个原始位组成一个字节，先到: A frame can carry zero to eight bytes. The length field determines where data ends; every eight original bits form one byte, most significant bit first. Stuff bits belong to no byte and do not advance its position.
这次从帧起始开始读一帧。把标识符、数据长度和每个字节分别交出来，以后才能把帧交给: This time read one frame from its start. Give out its identifier, data length and each byte separately, so higher layers can use them.
只在有效位到达时推进原始位的位置；标识符是位置 1 至 11，长度是位置 15: Advance the original-bit position only when a valid bit arrives; the identifier occupies positions 1–11 and the length positions 15–18.
数据从位置 19 开始，长度乘八是数据位数。数到数据结束后，不要把校验字段当成字: Data starts at position 19. Its length in bits is eight times the data length; do not read the CRC field as data.
在数据里另数字节中的 0 至 7，每凑满八位清零，从下一字节重新攒。: Count from 0 to 7 within the data byte. After eight bits, reset the count and gather the next byte.
长度为零时没有字节；长度为八时交出八次。填充位只改变到达的拍数，不改变字段位置。: A zero-length frame yields no bytes; a length of eight yields eight. Stuffing changes arrival ticks, not field positions.
位串在发送后有一位翻转。用解析器交出它读到的每个数据字节；其他拍交出「—」。: One bit in the transmitted stream has flipped. Use the parser to give each data byte it reads, and 「—」 on other ticks.
只按格式读出数据不能证明数据没变。接下来需要一种能让接收方发现错误的校验方法。: Reading fields by format cannot prove the data is unchanged. Next we need a check that lets the receiver detect errors.
发送方计划的数据和收到的位串同时给出。线路上有一位被翻转；解析器只按位的位置读字: The sender’s intended data and the received bit stream are both shown. A bit on the line has flipped; the parser reads the changed byte but cannot yet tell us an error occurred.
校验要把数据当成一个二进制多项式做除法。每一列的减法不借位：相同写 0，不同写: A check treats data as a binary polynomial and divides it. Subtraction in each column has no borrowing: equal bits give 0 and different bits give 1. This is XOR; the new part applies it bit by bit.
先用一个短生成式 1011 练习：把收到的位后面补三个 0，再做不借位的除法；余: Practise with the short generator 1011: append three zeroes to the received bits and divide without borrowing. The remainder has three bits. For example, 1101 followed by 000 divided by 1011 leaves 001.
每拍交出 A、B、C 三个位异或的结果。: Every tick, give the XOR of the three bits A, B and C.
对收到的位计算三位校验余数：生成式是 1011。只有「参与」为 1 才收进这一位: Calculate the three-bit check remainder of the received bits using generator 1011. Take a bit only when Enable is 1; when Reset is 1, clear first, then decide whether to take this tick’s bit. Give the current remainder every tick.
记住三位余数。每收一位，先把余数最高位与新位异或；余数左移一位，再按这结果决定是: Keep the three-bit remainder. For each received bit, XOR the top remainder bit with the new bit; shift the remainder left, then XOR 011 if that result is 1.
左移后最高位要丢掉；「参与」为 0 时保持余数，「重来」先清零。: Discard the bit shifted beyond the top. Hold the remainder when Enable is 0; Reset clears it first.
逐位算出的结果与把整串补零后做多项式长除法的余数相同。: The bit-by-bit result is the same remainder as polynomial long division of the complete bit string with zeroes appended.
经典 CAN 用 15 位余数，生成多项式是 x¹⁵ + x¹⁴ + x¹⁰ +: Classical CAN uses a 15-bit remainder and generator polynomial x¹⁵ + x¹⁴ + x¹⁰ + x⁸ + x⁷ + x⁴ + x³ + 1. Without its leading bit it is 0x4599. The bit-by-bit method is the same as in the short example.
每拍交出收到的有效位对应的 CRC-15 余数。「参与」为 0 时保持余数；「重: Every tick give the CRC-15 remainder for the enabled bits. Hold it when Enable is 0; when Reset is 1 clear first, then decide whether to take this tick’s bit.
最高位是 16384；左移后用异或去掉越过 15 位的那一位。: The top bit is 16384; after shifting left, XOR away the bit that crossed the 15-bit boundary.
最高位与新位不同才异或 0x4599。填充位不能参与，之后可用「参与」跳过它。: XOR with 0x4599 only when the top bit differs from the incoming bit. Stuff bits do not participate; later Enable can skip them.
逐位计算经典 CAN 的 CRC-15；「参与」为 0 时保持，「重来」为 1: Calculates Classical CAN CRC-15 bit by bit; holds when Enable is 0 and clears first when Reset is 1. Gives the remainder after this tick.
CRC 只处理从帧起始到数据字段末尾的原始位；实际总线上的填充位要先去除。: CRC covers the original bits from start of frame through the data field; stuff bits on the real bus must be removed first.
发送方把算出的 15 位校验码接在原始位后面。接收方从头计算，连校验码也一起收进: The sender appends the calculated 15-bit check sequence to the original bits. The receiver computes from the beginning and includes the check sequence; if no error occurred, the final remainder is zero.
位串已经去除填充位，包含数据和紧随其后的 15 位校验码。「结束」为 1 的拍交: The bit stream has already been destuffed and contains data followed by its 15-bit check sequence. On a tick when Finish is 1, give whether the check matches; give 「—」 on other ticks.
用搭好的 CRC-15 收进位串，结束拍比较余数与 0；每段的「重来」会从头计算: Feed the stream to your CRC-15 and compare its remainder with 0 on the finish tick. Reset starts each section afresh.
非零余数说明这一段不相符；零余数也不能证明绝对没有错误，因为某些错误模式可能碰巧: A nonzero remainder means the section does not match. A zero remainder does not prove there was no error: some error patterns can pass the check.
数据后面是 15 位 CRC 校验码。填充规则一直用到 CRC 校验码的最后一位: The data is followed by the 15-bit CRC sequence. Stuffing applies through its final bit; if that bit completes five equal bits, one last stuff bit follows it.
接下来依次是 CRC 界定位、应答位、应答界定位，以及连续七位隐性的帧结束。之后: Next come the CRC delimiter, ACK slot, ACK delimiter and seven recessive end-of-frame bits. The following three intermission bits are between frames, not part of end of frame.
从第一位开始读一帧。在帧结束字段的第七位到达时交出「是」，其余拍交出「—」。: Read a frame from its first bit. Give yes on the seventh end-of-frame bit and 「—」 on all other ticks.
数据长度决定 CRC 从哪里开始：帧起始到长度字段共 19 个原始位，数据有长度: The data length determines where CRC starts: start of frame through the length field is 19 original bits, followed by eight bits per data byte and 15 CRC bits.
在去填充后的下一位找到 CRC 界定位；从那里起按线上实际的拍数计，不再去除填充: Find the next valid bit after the CRC as its delimiter. From there count actual line ticks; stuffing no longer applies.
CRC 界定位后是应答位、应答界定位、七位帧结束。: After the CRC delimiter come the ACK slot, ACK delimiter and seven end-of-frame bits.
CRC 之后没有填充位；帧结束的七位隐性和后面的三位帧间隔各有用途。: Stuffing stops after CRC. The seven recessive EOF bits and the three following intermission bits have distinct roles.
一帧结束后，三位帧间隔一过，下一帧就可以紧接着开始。应答界定位、七位帧结束和三位: After a frame, the next may start as soon as the three-bit intermission ends. The ACK delimiter, seven EOF bits and three intermission bits make exactly eleven recessive bits in a row.
每次找到新的帧起始，都要重新开始数原始位和攒标识符；前一帧的填充计数也不能带进来: Each new start of frame must restart the original-bit position and identifier; the preceding frame’s stuff count must not carry over.
总线先安静至少十一拍，随后有多帧。每帧标识符的最后一个原始位到达时交出标识符，其: The bus is quiet for at least eleven ticks, then carries several frames. Give each identifier on its last original bit and 「—」 on other ticks.
用连续隐性和下一位显性找到帧起始；一帧紧接一帧时，帧尾同样提供足够的隐性位。: Find a start of frame from a run of recessive bits followed by a dominant bit. Even back-to-back frames have enough recessive bits at the end.
每次帧起始都从位置 0 和空标识符重来；数位置时跳过填充位。: Restart at position zero and an empty identifier on each start of frame; skip stuff bits when counting positions.
连续位的计数也从帧起始重置，不能把帧前的空闲位算进填充规则。: Restart the equal-bit count at start of frame as well; idle bits before the frame are not part of stuffing.
帧间隔允许紧接着开始下一帧；每次重新初始化，才能把相邻的帧分开。: Intermission permits the next frame to follow immediately. Restarting the state each time keeps adjacent frames separate.
输入是已经填充的位串。原始位到来时交出它并让「有效」为是；填充位那一拍交出「—」: The input is a stuffed bit stream. Give each original bit and set Valid to yes; give 「—」 and Valid no on a stuff bit. When Reset is 1, clear the count first and then process this tick’s bit.
跳过填充位；该拍交出「—」并让「有效」为否，其余拍交出位并让「有效」为是。「重来: Skips stuff bits, giving 「—」 and Valid no on those ticks, otherwise giving the bit and Valid yes. Reset clears the state before processing the current bit. Each part has its own registers.
从帧起始读帧，在对应字段的最后一位交出标识符、长度和每个数据字节；其他拍交出「—: Reads frames from start of frame, giving each identifier, length and data byte on the last bit of its field and 「—」 on other ticks. Reset clears the state before this bit. It does not check CRC or locate frame starts.
从帧起始读一帧或连续帧：「重来」为 1 时先清空状态，再处理这一位。在标识符和长: Read one or more frames from their starts. When Reset is 1, clear the state before processing this bit. Give the identifier and length on each field’s last bit and each data byte when complete; give 「—」 on other ticks.
先把探针插上总线。它必须等足够长的隐性空闲，认出帧起始，才让解析器从这一位重来；: First connect the probe to the bus. It must wait for a long enough recessive idle and find the start of frame before restarting the parser on that bit; it must not invent fields before then.
总线先空闲，再来一帧。交出这帧的标识符、长度和每个字节：各在字段或字节的最后一位: The bus is idle, then one frame arrives. Give its identifier, length and each data byte on the last bit of the field or byte, and 「—」 on other ticks.
用计数器找连续至少 11 位隐性之后的第一个显性，把它接到解析器的「重来」。: Use a counter to find the first dominant bit after at least 11 recessive bits and connect it to the parser’s Reset input.
一块抓帧器把找到起点和读字段接了起来；它还没有检查 CRC。: The capture device combines finding a start with reading fields; it does not yet check CRC.
从连续总线上找到帧起始，读出各帧标识符、长度和数据字节；尚不检查 CRC。: Finds frame starts on a continuous bus and reads each identifier, length and data byte; does not yet check CRC.
现在把抓帧器接到连续的总线，记录每帧的字段，也给每帧一个从 1 开始的序号。帧可: Now connect the capture device to a continuous bus. Record the fields of each frame and number the frames from 1. Frames may be adjacent, with only the three-bit intermission.
在每个帧起始交出它的序号；同时交出每帧标识符、长度和每个数据字节。每项在没有新值: At each start of frame give its index; also give each identifier, length and data byte. For each output give 「—」 on ticks with no new value.
每找到一个帧起始，让寄存卡里的帧数加一；帧的其他字段交给抓帧器。: Increment a register whenever you find a start of frame; leave field reading to the capture device.
每次帧起始都会重新开始解析，帧序号则跨帧保留。: Each start of frame restarts parsing, while the frame count persists across frames.
填充区域中，连续五个相同位之后必须出现相反位。如果第六位仍然相同，就出现填充错误: In the stuffed region, five equal bits must be followed by the opposite bit. If the sixth bit is equal too, a stuffing error has occurred; the receiver must remember it.
仅在「参与」为 1 的拍检查输入位；出现六个连续相同位后，错误输出为 1 并保持: Inspect the input bit only when Enable is 1. After six identical bits in a row, output 1 and retain the error. Reset first clears the state, then decides whether to inspect this bit.
记住上一位和连续相同位的个数。数到五后，下一位若与上一位相同就记下错误；否则那一: Remember the previous bit and the length of its run. Once the count reaches five, the next bit is an error if equal, otherwise it starts the next run.
填充错误与 CRC 错误是两种不同的检测：前者可在第六个相同位出现时立即发现。: A stuffing error and a CRC error are different checks: the first can be detected as soon as the sixth identical bit arrives.
检查启用期间的连续位；六位相同就记下错误，直到重来。「重来」先清空状态，再处理这: Checks enabled consecutive bits, retaining an error after six equal bits until reset. Reset clears first, then processes the current tick.
帧起始重置去填充器、CRC 和填充检查。CRC 接收从帧起始到 CRC 序列末尾: Reset destuffing, CRC and stuffing check at start of frame. CRC receives original bits from start of frame through the end of the CRC sequence.
帧长确定 CRC 的结束位置：19 位头部、长度乘八位数据、15 位 CRC。最: The frame length determines the CRC end: 19 header bits, eight bits per data byte and 15 CRC bits. If the last CRC bit triggers stuffing, check that extra bit too.
一旦发现填充错误先交出「否」，同一帧不要再给第二次结果。: Report no as soon as a stuffing error is detected, and do not give a second result for that frame.
非零 CRC 或填充错误都能让接收方发现问题；校验通过也不意味着所有可能的错误都: A nonzero CRC or a stuffing error can reveal a problem; a matching check does not rule out every possible error.
最后把连续帧里的校验结果排成一份记录：帧的序号和校验结果分别在它们出现的那一拍交: Finally make a record of consecutive frames: give the frame index and check result on the ticks where each arrives.
每次帧起始交出从 1 开始的序号；每帧检测到的填充错误或 CRC 结果交给「相符: Give a one-based index at each start of frame; give the stuffing-error or CRC result for each frame on Matches, and 「—」 on other ticks.
这台监听探针能分开连续帧，并指出测试中的 CRC 和填充错误。它还只能听：想主动: This probe separates consecutive frames and detects the CRC and stuffing errors in these tests. It can only listen; to ask a controller a question, the next generation must speak.
解析字段之后，还要判断这一帧能不能相信：边收原始位边核对 CRC，同时留意填充错: After parsing fields, decide whether the frame can be trusted: check CRC as original bits arrive and watch for stuffing errors. Here errors occur in data, CRC or stuff bits and do not change the length field.
怎样让探针开口，还不打断别人？: How can the probe speak without interrupting others?
探针已经会听，但光听不能向控制器提问。现在给它一个说话口：每拍先决定自己说什么，: The probe can listen, but listening alone cannot ask a controller a question. Give it a sending port: each tick it first decides what to say, then hears the actual bus bit.
总线上只要有一个节点说 0，大家听到的就是 0；所有节点都说 1 才听到 1。说: If any node says 0, everyone hears 0; only when all say 1 does the bus carry 1. The current bus bit cannot be heard before deciding what to say this tick.
每拍把上一拍的「位」说到总线上；第一拍说 1。同时交出这一拍实际听到的总线位。这: Each tick, send the previous tick’s Bit onto the bus; send 1 on the first tick. Also give the actual bus bit heard this tick. Other nodes remain silent here.
把「位」存到寄存卡，用读寄存卡的输出接说话口；初值设为 1。: Keep Bit in a register and connect its read output to the sending port; set its initial value to 1.
听到的总线位从总线元件交出。说话口不能依赖同一拍听到的总线，否则引擎会指出回路。: Give the heard bus bit from the bus card. The sending port cannot depend on the same tick’s bus, or the engine reports a loop.
说和听发生在同一拍的两个阶段。先前保存的值可以决定这一拍说什么；这一拍听到的值只: Speaking and hearing are two phases of the same tick. A previously stored value can decide what to send; what is heard now can affect later ticks only.
比较当前数与 128 可以知道最高位。: Compare the current number with 128 to find its top bit.
去掉最高位后左移一位，把结果记到下一拍；另数从 0 到 7 的位置。: Remove the top bit, shift left and store the result for the next tick; count positions 0 to 7 separately.
「开始」重置位置并装入新的字节；空闲时不送位。: Start resets the position and loads a new byte; while idle, give no bit.
每拍只送一位，但寄存卡让发送过程跨八拍记住同一个字节。: Only one bit is sent per tick, but registers retain the same byte through all eight ticks.
把逐位送出的元件接到说话口。它空闲时，节点不拉低总线，也就是对总线说隐性 1。: Connect the bit-by-bit sender to the speaking port. While idle the node does not pull the bus low, so it says recessive 1.
「开始」时开始逐拍发送交来的字节，最高位在前；空闲时说 1。同时交出「完成」：只: On Start, begin sending the given byte one bit per tick, most significant first; say 1 while idle. Also give Done, which is yes only on the final bit. Other nodes stay silent.
用逐位送出元件的「忙」选择：忙时说它的位，空闲时说 1。: Use the sender’s Busy output to choose its bit while busy and 1 while idle.
把字节锁存后逐位发送，其他节点就能在同一根线上按相同的顺序收到它。: Once the byte is stored and sent bit by bit, other nodes on the same line can receive it in the same order.
一帧的填充区域不能连续说六个相同位。发送方每说完五个相同位，就先插入一个相反位，: A frame’s stuffed region cannot contain six equal bits in a row. After sending five equal bits, the sender first inserts an opposite bit, then continues with the original data.
插入填充位的那一拍不取走原始位；来源要把它留到下一拍。插入的位也算下一段连续位的: A stuff-bit tick does not consume the original input bit; the source must hold it for the next tick. The inserted bit also starts the next run of equal bits.
「有位」为 1 表示来源提供原始位。正常时交出这一位并让「取走」为 1；若需要填: Valid 1 means the source offers an original bit. Normally give that bit and set Accepted to 1; when stuffing is due, first give the opposite bit, set Stuff to yes and Accepted to 0, even if no input bit is offered. With no bit and no stuffing due, give 「—」. Start clears the state before this tick.
记住上一位和连续相同位数。数到五后，下一拍输出相反位，不取原始位。: Remember the previous bit and its run length. After five, output the opposite bit on the next tick without accepting the input.
插入的位是新的一段的第一位；只有实际交出位的拍才更新状态。: The inserted bit starts the next run; update state only on ticks that give a bit.
接收方会把这些多出的位去掉；双方都按线上实际连续的位数判断填充。: The receiver removes these extra bits; both ends count runs on the actual line.
对启用的原始位串插入填充位。「取走」说明输入是否被接受，「填充」标出插入的拍；开: Inserts stuff bits into enabled original bits. Accepted tells whether the input was taken and Stuff marks an inserted bit; Start clears the state first.
把插入填充位的元件接到说话口。原始位暂时没有提供时，只有已经欠下的填充位需要继续: Connect the stuffer to the speaking port. When no original bit is offered, a pending stuff bit still must be sent; otherwise the node says recessive 1.
按输入的「有位」和「开始」发送位串，需要时先插入填充位；没有位可发送时说 1。同: Send the input stream according to Valid and Start, inserting stuff bits when needed. Say 1 when there is nothing to send. Give Accepted so the source knows when to offer the next bit.
插入填充位元件的「填充」为是时，即便「有位」为 0，也有一位必须说出去。: When the stuffer’s Stuff output is yes, there is a bit to send even if Valid is 0.
填充会让线上比原始数据多出拍数；用「取走」让来源在这些拍上停住。: Stuffing adds ticks to the original stream. Accepted lets the source hold its bit during those ticks.
要把一个字节送到一根线，先把它拆成八拍：最高位先说，最低位最后说。开始时锁存字节: To send a byte over one line, split it across eight ticks, most significant first. Latch it at Start; if the receiver cannot take the current bit yet, the sender must hold it.
「开始」为 1 的拍取入「字节」并交出最高位；「前进」为 1 才取走当前位并移动: When Start is 1, load Byte and give its most significant bit. Advance 1 accepts the current bit and moves to the next; otherwise hold it. After eight accepted bits, Bit is 「—」. Busy means bits remain and Done is yes only when the final bit is accepted. Another start replaces the unfinished byte.
开始时装入字节并逐位交出（最高位先）；前进为 1 时才移到下一位。忙表示还有位，: Loads a byte on start and offers its bits most significant first; moves to the next only when Advance is 1. Busy means bits remain; Done is yes only when the final bit is accepted. Another start replaces an unfinished byte.
逐位发送器和填充发送器要接成一条流水线。填充发送器插入额外的一位时，不会取走原始: Connect the serializer and stuffer into a pipeline. When the stuffer inserts an extra bit it does not accept the original bit, so the serializer must hold that bit until accepted.
「开始」时取入一个字节，按最高位先送到总线，并按规则插入填充位。原字节最后一位被: On Start, load a byte and send it most significant first, inserting stuff bits as required. Done is yes when the last original bit is accepted; if it triggers stuffing, the extra bit must still be sent on the following tick. Say 1 while idle.
逐位发送器的「位」和「忙」接到填充发送器的原始位和「有位」。: Connect the serializer’s Bit and Busy to the stuffer’s original bit and Valid inputs.
将填充发送器的「取走」接回逐位发送器的「前进」；每块元件用寄存卡跨拍保存状态。: Connect the stuffer’s Accepted back to the serializer’s Advance; each part stores state in registers across ticks.
有原始位或填充位要发时接说话口，否则说隐性 1。: Drive the speaking port when an original or stuff bit is available, otherwise say recessive 1.
握手让额外的填充拍不丢失原始位；字节完成后仍可能欠一个填充位。: The handshake prevents extra stuff ticks from losing original bits; a byte can finish with one more stuff bit still owed.
发送一帧时，CRC 要跟着原始位计算，而线上还会插入填充位。先用一个字节练习：发: When sending a frame, CRC is calculated over the original bits even though the line also carries inserted stuff bits. Practise with one byte: send it and give its CRC-15.
按最高位先发送输入字节并插入填充位；空闲时说 1。最后一个原始位被取走的那一拍交: Send the byte most significant bit first, inserting stuff bits; say 1 while idle. Give its CRC-15 on the tick the final original bit is accepted and 「—」 on other ticks.
将逐位发送器的位送给 CRC；只有填充发送器取走原始位时才让 CRC 参与。: Feed the serializer’s bit to CRC; enable CRC only when the stuffer accepts the original bit.
开始时重置 CRC。插入位也要送到总线，但不能送进 CRC。: Reset CRC on Start. Stuff bits go onto the bus but must not enter the CRC calculation.
CRC 计算的是原始位串；线上的填充位用来保持同步，不属于校验输入。: CRC is calculated over the original bit stream. Stuff bits on the line support synchronisation and are not CRC input.
逐位送字段: Send a field bit by bit
CAN 的字段宽度并不都相同：长度占四位，标准标识符占十一位，CRC 占十五位。: CAN fields do not all have the same width: length has four bits, a standard identifier eleven, and CRC fifteen. Extend bit-by-bit sending to different widths to reuse the same logic.
开始时锁存「数」和「位数」，逐位交出数（最高位在前）。可用位数是 1、4、8、1: At Start, latch Number and Width and offer its bits most significant first. Width can be 1, 4, 8, 11 or 15, and the given number fits. Hold the current bit when Advance is 0; Done is yes only when the final bit is accepted. Another start replaces an unfinished field.
最高位的值由位数决定：1、8、128、1024 或 16384。: The highest bit has value 1, 8, 128, 1024 or 16384 depending on width.
开始时把位数也存起来；之后输入位数可能改变。: Store the width at Start too; its input may change later.
参考逐位送字节的办法，去掉最高位并左移；另记位置和是否仍有位。: As with sending a byte, remove the highest bit and shift left; track position and whether bits remain.
字段长度在开始时确定；下游暂停时，当前位和位置都不前进。: The field width is fixed at Start; when the downstream pauses, neither its current bit nor position advances.
开始时锁存数和位数，支持 1、4、8、11、15 位；最高位先交出，前进为 1: Latches number and width on Start, supporting 1, 4, 8, 11 and 15 bits; offers the most significant bit first and advances only when permitted. Busy means a bit remains; Done is yes only when the final bit is accepted.
用不同宽度的字段发送器试一试暂停：测试台没有取走这一位时，发送器要保住它，线路暂: Try pausing the field sender at different widths: when the test bench does not accept a bit, hold it and let the line say recessive temporarily.
开始时取入数和位数；「前进」为 1 且字段仍有位时，说出当前位并取走它。其余拍说: At Start, load Number and Width. When Advance is 1 and bits remain, send and accept the current bit. Say 1 on other ticks; Done is yes when the final bit is accepted.
无论字段有几位，是否前进都由下游决定。下一步要把不同字段依次拼成一帧。: Whatever the field width, the downstream decides whether to advance. Next, fields must be assembled into a frame.
完整帧的数据可能有多个字节。发送器先看到队首字节，交出「取走」后，来源才在下一拍: A complete frame may carry several data bytes. The sender sees the queue head first; after it signals Accepted, the source presents the next byte on the following tick. An empty queue must not start a new transmission.
按队列顺序把每个字节逐位说到总线，最高位先，字节之间不加空拍；队列空后说隐性 1: Send the queued bytes in order, one bit per tick with the most significant first and no gap between bytes. Say recessive 1 when the queue is empty. Give yes on Accepted when the final bit of a byte is sent.
「有字节」为 1 且发送器不在处理字节时，启动逐位发送器。: Start the serializer when a byte is available and it is not already sending one.
完成那一拍取走队首；下一拍才会出现下一个字节。: Accept the queue head on the completion tick; the next byte appears on the following tick.
来源按握手逐个提供字节；这让帧的数据部分不必预先把所有字节都放进寄存卡。: A source supplies bytes one at a time through a handshake; the data section need not put every byte into a register in advance.
把起始位、11 位标识符、控制位、4 位数据长度、数据和 15 位 CRC 依次: Send the start bit, 11-bit identifier, control bits, four-bit data length, data and 15-bit CRC in order. Stuffing applies to original bits from start through CRC; then send the CRC delimiter, ACK slot, ACK delimiter, end of frame and intermission.
本关的标识符和长度在整帧期间保持不变；数据由队列逐字节提供，队首标志指出最后一个: In this level the identifier and length remain fixed throughout the frame. Data comes one byte at a time from a queue whose last flag marks its final byte. The sender releases the ACK slot so another node can pull it low.
分阶段生成原始位：起始、标识符、三个控制位、长度、数据、CRC；用逐位送字段和队: Generate original bits in phases: start, identifier, three control bits, length, data and CRC. Reuse the field sender and queue handshake.
CRC 只收起始到数据末尾被取走的原始位。数据最后一位被取走时保存它，随后按 1: CRC accepts only original bits from start through the end of data. Save it when the last data bit is accepted, or at the end of length for zero bytes; then send its 15 bits.
CRC 的最后一位可能还欠一个填充位；先发完它，再按实际拍数发送界定、应答、帧结: The last CRC bit may still owe a stuff bit. Send it first, then count actual ticks through delimiters, ACK, end of frame and intermission.
发送方在应答位不拉低总线；有没有其他节点应答，要在听的阶段读回实际总线。: The sender releases the bus in the ACK slot; whether another node acknowledges must be read back in the hearing phase.
同一拍里，节点说出的位与总线上听到的位可能不同。发送方在应答位说隐性；若有接收方: Within one tick the bit a node says can differ from what it hears on the bus. The sender says recessive in the ACK slot; a receiver that accepted the frame pulls the bus dominant.
用搭好的发送器发一帧，同时逐拍交出实际听到的总线位。测试包含有应答和没有应答两种: Use your transmitter to send one frame and also give the actual bus bit each tick. Tests include both acknowledged and unacknowledged frames; take each queue byte at its last original bit.
应答位是否被拉低来自其他节点；只看发送方自己说的位无法知道有没有接收方应答。: The ACK slot is pulled low by another node. Looking only at what the sender says cannot show whether a receiver acknowledged.
两个节点同时开始说话时，不需要先商量：它们一位一位地说标识符，也同时听总线。说隐: When nodes start together, they need no prior negotiation: each sends its identifier one bit at a time while listening to the bus. A node that says recessive 1 but hears dominant 0 loses and releases the bus from the next tick.
只有仲裁段中的这种差异代表仲裁落败。应答位或数据段也可能听到不同的位，不能把这些: Only this difference in the arbitration field means arbitration was lost. A different bit can also be heard in the ACK or data field; those must not all be called arbitration loss.
「待发送位」给出本节点原本准备说的帧位，「仲裁段」标出正在仲裁的拍。「开始」先清: Intended bit gives the bit this node planned to send; Arbitration marks the arbitration ticks. Start clears the loss state first. Drive the bus each tick; Lost is 1 from the tick arbitration is lost, and the node says 1 from the next tick.
先根据寄存卡里上一拍是否落败，决定这一拍说原位还是放开总线。: Use the register’s previous loss state to choose this tick’s intended bit or release.
听到本拍总线后，只在仲裁段比较自己说的与听到的；说 1 而听到 0 就记下落败。: After hearing the bus, compare what you said with what you heard only during arbitration; remember a loss when you said 1 and heard 0.
说和听分成两半：这一拍的听到只能改变下一拍的发送，不能接回本拍的说话口。: Speaking and hearing are separate phases: what is heard now can change the next tick, not the current sending port.

从待发送位和仲裁段标志决定驱动；仲裁段说 1 却听到 0 时记下落败，下一拍起放: Drives intended bits during arbitration; if it says 1 but hears 0 in the arbitration field, it records a loss and releases the bus from the next tick. Start resets it.
把仲裁元件放进自己的节点。竞争者也会听到总线：它们一旦在仲裁段落败，就在下一拍退: Put the arbitration part in your node. Competitors listen too: once they lose arbitration, they withdraw on the next tick.
用搭好的仲裁元件驱动总线并交出落败状态；同时交出实际听到的总线。测试包含竞争者先: Use your arbitration part to drive the bus and give the loss state; also give the actual bus bit. Tests include both a competitor losing first and your node losing first.
所有竞争者逐拍做同一个比较；没有中央节点逐个发号施令。: Every competitor performs the same comparison each tick; no central node issues commands one by one.
仲裁落败并不表示总线停了：赢家还在继续发送。输的一方要从发送转为监听，把赢家的帧: Losing arbitration does not stop the bus: the winner continues sending. The loser must switch from transmitting to listening and receive the winner’s frame.
节点从空闲后开始竞争。落败后放开总线，并在赢家标识符的最后一位交出该标识符；没有: The node competes after an idle period. After losing, release the bus and give the winner’s identifier on its final original bit; give no identifier if this node did not lose. Give the loss state each tick.
让仲裁元件控制说话口；同时让校验抓帧器一直听实际总线。: Let the arbitration part control the sending port while the checked capture device listens to the actual bus.
只在已落败时转交抓帧器读出的标识符。: Pass through the identifier read by the capture device only after this node has lost.
输掉仲裁不会破坏赢家的帧；转为接收后，输的一方仍能听懂赢家说的内容。: Losing arbitration does not damage the winner’s frame. Once the loser becomes a receiver it can still understand what the winner sent.
落败后不能只收标识符：还要收长度与每个数据字节，并检查 CRC。正确接收的节点会: After losing, receive more than the identifier: take the length and every data byte and check CRC. A node that received the frame correctly says dominant in the following ACK slot.
竞争后若本节点落败，接收赢家的标识符、长度、每个字节和校验结果；赢家帧校验正确时: If this node loses arbitration, receive the winner’s identifier, length, each byte and check result; if the check passes, say 0 in the ACK slot. Do not give these received values when this node did not lose. Give the loss state each tick.
让校验抓帧器持续听总线，用它的「结果就绪」识别 CRC 界定位。: Keep the checked capture device listening; use Result ready to recognise the CRC delimiter.
校验结果为是且已经落败时，记下需要应答；下一拍从寄存卡驱动显性 0。: When the check is yes and this node has lost, remember that an ACK is needed; drive dominant 0 from the register on the next tick.
只在落败时转交抓帧器的字段和校验结果。: Pass through capture fields and check result only after losing.
在仲裁后转为接收，正确接收时应答；应答位比 CRC 界定位晚一拍，不能用本拍听到: After losing arbitration, become a receiver and acknowledge a correctly received frame. ACK is one tick after the CRC delimiter, so what is heard now cannot drive the bus in the same tick.
仲裁输了之后，自己的帧还没有送出去。先收下赢家并在正确接收时应答，再等帧间隔结束: After losing arbitration, the node has not sent its frame. Receive and acknowledge the winner if correct, then wait for intermission and an idle bus before sending the original frame again.
「开始」时尝试发送自己的标准帧。若仲裁落败，接收并应答赢家，等待至少 11 位连: On Start, attempt to send your standard frame. After losing arbitration, receive and acknowledge the winner, wait for at least 11 consecutive recessive bits, then retransmit; if you win initially, do not retry. Take each queued byte only when your own byte has actually been sent.
用发送器的「仲裁段」和说出的位接仲裁元件；落败后屏蔽数据队列的可用信号，不能提前: Connect the sender’s arbitration flag and intended bit to the arbiter. While waiting after loss, hide queue availability so your bytes cannot be consumed early.
让抓帧器持续监听，正确接收赢家后在下一拍应答。: Keep the capture device listening and acknowledge a correctly received winner on the next tick.
落败时数总线的连续隐性位；数够 11 位后重新启动发送器和仲裁元件。: After losing, count consecutive recessive bus bits; restart the transmitter and arbiter once the count reaches 11.
仲裁失败不是发送错误：赢家不受打断，输家保留待发数据并在总线空闲后再试。: Arbitration loss is not a transmission error: the winner is not interrupted, and the loser retains its pending data and tries again when the bus is idle.
我说的不是我听到的: What I said is not what I heard
节点发送时也会读回总线。仲裁段说 1 听到 0 是落败；应答位说 1 听到 0: A node reads the bus while transmitting. In arbitration, saying 1 and hearing 0 means loss; in the ACK slot it may be a receiver acknowledging. Elsewhere, a difference between the sent and sampled bit is a bit error.
按「待发送位」驱动总线。除「仲裁段」和「应答位」之外，若听到的位与说的不同，把「: Drive Intended bit onto the bus. Outside Arbitration and ACK, retain Error as 1 if the heard bit differs from the sent bit; Start clears the error first. Tests invert the sampled bus on specified ticks.
先比较说出的位和听到的总线位；只在仲裁段和应答位都为 0 时把差异当作位错误。: Compare the sent bit with the bus; treat a difference as a bit error only when both Arbitration and ACK are 0.
用寄存卡保持错误；开始时先清零。: Use a register to retain the error and clear it first on Start.
应答和仲裁有各自的解释；其他位置的读回不符表示发送方观察到了位错误。: ACK and arbitration have their own meanings; elsewhere a readback mismatch means the transmitter observed a bit error.
主动错误节点发现错误后，要让别的节点也看见。它从下一拍起连续说六位显性，故意违反: After detecting an error, an error-active node must make it visible to others. From the next tick it sends six dominant bits, deliberately violating normal frame stuffing; eight recessive error-delimiter bits follow.
「错误」为 1 的下一拍开始说六个 0，再说八个 1；八位界定的最后一拍让「完成: On the tick after Error is 1, send six 0 bits and then eight 1 bits. Done is yes on the last delimiter bit and no on other ticks. Say 1 while idle. Error events do not overlap in these tests.
用寄存卡记住标志进行到哪一拍：发现错误时存入起点，下一拍才开始说显性。: Use a register for the flag position: store the beginning when an error is detected; dominant bits start on the next tick.
前六拍说 0，接下来的八拍说 1；走完以后保持空闲。: Say 0 for the first six ticks and 1 for the next eight; remain idle afterwards.
六个连续显性位破坏正常帧的填充约定，让其他节点也能发现错误；界定之后还需要帧间隔: Six consecutive dominant bits violate normal frame stuffing so other nodes can detect the error. Intermission is still needed after the delimiter.
错误后从下一拍驱动六位显性，再保持八位隐性界定；完成在最后一个界定位为是。: Starts a six-bit dominant active error flag on the tick after Error, followed by eight recessive delimiter bits. Done is yes on the last delimiter bit.
把发送位错误检测接到主动错误标志。发现错误的那一拍已经说出去了；节点从下一拍开始: Connect transmitted-bit error detection to an active error flag. The current bit has already been sent when the error is detected; interrupt the original frame and send the flag from the next tick.
按待发送位驱动总线。仲裁段和应答位之外一旦读回不符，记下错误并从下一拍起发送六位: Drive the intended bits. Outside arbitration and ACK, retain a readback error and from the next tick send six dominant error-flag bits and eight recessive delimiter bits, then remain idle. This level models one error-active node and no retry.
先排除仲裁和应答；错误检测的同拍结果交给主动错误标志。: As before, exclude arbitration and ACK; give the same-tick detection to the active error flag.
用寄存卡记住已经中断原帧；说话口在下一拍切换到错误标志。: Use a register to remember that the original frame was interrupted; switch the sending port to the flag on the next tick.
主动错误标志让其他节点也能检测到当前帧已经出错；完整恢复还需要错误计数和重发。: An active error flag lets other nodes detect that the current frame failed. Full recovery also needs error counters and retransmission.
控制器分别记发送错误计数 TEC 和接收错误计数 REC。常见发送错误加 8，接: A controller keeps separate transmit and receive error counters, TEC and REC. A common transmit error adds 8 and a receive error adds 1; success reduces the corresponding counter. At thresholds the node must reduce its influence on the bus.
这里的事件是受控子集：0 无事、1 一般发送错误、2 发送成功、3 接收错误、4: These events are a controlled subset: 0 none, 1 ordinary transmit error, 2 successful transmission, 3 receive error, 4 successful reception, 5 missing ACK with no dominant bit during the passive error flag. Event 5 does not increase TEC in the passive state; for successful reception with REC over 127, this exercise chooses the permitted value 127.
按事件逐拍更新 TEC 与 REC：计数不低于 0；一般发送错误加 8、发送成功: Update TEC and REC on each event without going below zero: ordinary transmit errors add 8 and transmit success subtracts 1; receive errors add 1 and receive success subtracts 1, or sets REC to 127 when it exceeds 127. Give the updated counters and state: 0 active, 1 passive, 2 bus-off. Start clears state first.
TEC 或 REC 到 128 进入被动；TEC 到 256 进入下线。: TEC or REC reaching 128 enters passive; TEC reaching 256 enters bus-off.
区分一般发送错误与事件 5；被动状态下事件 5 不加 TEC。: Distinguish ordinary transmit errors from event 5, which does not add TEC while passive.
下线后保持下线，忽略后续事件，直到练习的开始信号重新初始化。: Once bus-off, retain it and ignore events until the exercise Start signal reinitialises the node.
这些事件展示主要计数关系及一种缺应答例外；真实标准还列出其他错误标志、接收和恢复: These events illustrate the main counting relationships and a missing-ACK exception; the full standard also specifies other error-flag, reception and recovery cases.
按本练习的事件子集更新 TEC 和 REC，输出 0 主动、1 被动、2 下线；: Updates TEC and REC for this exercise’s event subset; gives 0 active, 1 passive, 2 bus-off. Bus-off is latched until Start reinitialises it.
一旦 TEC 或 REC 到 128，节点进入被动错误状态。被动节点发现错误时说: When TEC or REC reaches 128, the node becomes error passive. A passive node sends six recessive error-flag bits instead of pulling the bus low; at TEC 256 it goes bus-off and sends nothing.
先用错误计数得到状态；下线时不要启动错误标志，被动时保留标志时长但不驱动显性。: Get the state from the error counters; do not start an error flag while bus-off, and retain the flag duration without driving dominant when passive.
状态限制的是节点对总线的影响：被动节点不再用显性错误标志打断其他节点，下线节点不: State limits the node’s effect on the bus: a passive node no longer interrupts others with a dominant error flag, while a bus-off node does not send.
发送方在应答位说 1，并读取实际总线。若这一拍仍是 1，就没有节点应答；这不是仲: The sender says 1 in the ACK slot and reads the actual bus. If it is still 1, no node acknowledged. This is an ACK error, not arbitration loss.
发送一帧，在应答位交出是否缺应答，其余拍交出「—」。测试包括有应答和无应答；本关: Send a frame and give whether acknowledgement is missing on its ACK slot, or 「—」 on other ticks. Tests include both acknowledged and unacknowledged frames; this level detects the error without interrupting or retrying.
发送器标出应答位；在那一拍比较总线与隐性 1。: The transmitter marks the ACK slot; compare the bus with recessive 1 on that tick.
缺应答要单独判断：应答位的显性是正常回答，隐性则表示没有接收到应答。: Missing ACK needs its own check: dominant in the ACK slot is a normal response, whereas recessive means no acknowledgement was received.
如果应答位一直是隐性，发送方报告错误，等错误界定段和帧间隔结束后重新发送同一帧。: If the ACK slot stays recessive, the sender reports an error and retries the same frame after the error delimiter and intermission. This exercise covers a small number of missing ACKs while error-active.
组合发送器、错误标志和错误计数器；错误标志后数连续的隐性位。重发需要重新取出原来: Combine the transmitter, error flag, and fault counter; count consecutive recessive bits after the flag. Retrying requires reading the original bytes again.
缺应答会使错误主动的发送方增加发送错误计数，并中断当前帧。错误处理之后，发送方重: A missing ACK increases an error-active sender’s transmit error count and interrupts the current frame. After error handling the sender retries the original frame. The error-passive exception is outside this exercise.
错误被动节点发送完一帧或错误帧后，帧间隔结束还要多等八位，才可以再次主动发送。主: After an error-passive node transmits a frame or error frame, it must wait another eight bits after intermission before initiating another transmission. An error-active node needs no extra wait; a bus-off node cannot transmit.
「间隔结束」为 1 时记住状态并重新开始等待。状态 0 表示主动、1 表示被动、: When Intermission end is 1, remember the state and restart the wait. State 0 is active, 1 is passive, and 2 is bus-off. The bus remains idle: active nodes can send from the next tick; passive nodes wait the following eight ticks and can send from the ninth. Bus-off nodes cannot send. Another intermission end restarts the wait.
记住是否已经遇到间隔结束，以及当时的状态。计数器在每次间隔结束时重来。: Remember whether intermission has ended and the state at that moment. Restart the counter on every intermission end.
被动节点的额外八位称为发送暂停。这里总线保持空闲；若别的节点先开口，真实节点会先: The passive node’s extra eight bits are called suspend transmission. Here the bus stays idle; if another node starts first, a real node receives that frame.
记住帧间隔结束时的状态；空闲总线上，被动发送方额外等待八拍，主动发送方无需额外等: Remembers the state at intermission end. On an idle bus, passive senders wait eight extra ticks, active senders need no extra wait, and bus-off nodes cannot transmit.
发送请求可能在节点尚未等完时到达。把刚搭出的发送暂停元件接到请求上，让节点只在允: A transmit request may arrive before the node has waited long enough. Connect your suspend-transmission component to the request so the node starts only when allowed.
在空闲总线上，只有收到发送请求并且发送暂停已经结束，才回答「是」。状态在每次间隔: On an idle bus, answer yes only when a transmission is requested and suspend transmission has ended. Sample state at each intermission end.
用发送暂停元件判断是否已等够，再与发送请求组合。: Use the suspend-transmission component to determine when the wait is over, and combine it with the transmit request.
等待和请求是两个条件：被动节点不能因为有请求而跳过额外的八位。: Waiting and a request are separate conditions: a passive node cannot skip its extra eight bits just because a request is pending.
跨过门槛的那一次: The error that crosses the threshold
计数达到 128 时节点变为被动。导致这次转换的错误仍由此前的主动节点报告，所以: A node becomes error-passive when a counter reaches 128. The error causing this transition is still reported by the previously active node, so it sends an active error flag; subsequent errors use passive flags.
逐拍更新错误计数和状态。报告与错误事件同时出现，从下一拍开始发送对应标志和界定段: Update the error counts and state each tick. Report arrives with an error event; from the next tick send the corresponding flag and delimiter. The error that changes active to passive still sends six dominant bits. Tests have no overlapping flags and report occurs only with an error event; bus-off nodes do not send.
记住错误发生前的状态，并在报告时锁存标志类型。状态转为被动不能改变正在发送的主动: Remember the state before the error and latch the flag type on Report. Entering passive state must not change an active flag already being sent.
进入被动状态的那一次错误发主动标志；之后检测到的错误才按被动状态报告。: The error that enters passive state produces an active flag; later errors are reported according to the passive state.
按事件更新状态。收到「报告」时，从下一拍开始发送对应的错误标志和八位隐性界定：主: Update the state from the events. On Report, send the corresponding error flag and eight-bit recessive delimiter starting on the next tick: active says six 0s, passive says six 1s, and bus-off does not transmit. Output the state and completion signal. Flags do not overlap in the tests; the state does not change at Report or during a flag.
如果被动发送方收不到应答，而且被动错误标志期间没有检测到显性，它的发送错误计数不: When a passive sender misses an ACK and detects no dominant bit during its passive error flag, that error does not increase its transmit error count. It still retries, waiting another eight bits after intermission.
准备阶段给 16 次一般发送错误，使计数达到 128；这是直接提供事件的练习，不: The preparation stage gives 16 ordinary transmit errors to reach a count of 128; this exercise supplies events directly instead of simulating those 16 frames.
错误标志结束后再等三个帧间隔位，把间隔结束接到发送暂停元件；被动标志期间总线保持: After the error flag finishes, wait three intermission bits and connect intermission end to the suspend-transmission component. The bus remains recessive throughout the passive flag.
缺应答不会单独让满足该例外的被动节点下线。帧成功后计数下降；真实总线上还要处理其: Missing ACK alone does not force a passive node satisfying this exception bus-off. Its count decreases after a successful frame. A real bus must also handle other nodes starting during the wait or driving dominant during the error flag.
发送一帧标准格式数据帧，并标出仲裁段、应答位与帧结束末位。标识符与长度需保持到发: Sends one standard-format data frame and marks arbitration, ACK and the last end-of-frame bit. Keep identifier and length stable until Done and supply data from the queue. Outputs driven bits, byte acceptance and completion; arbitration loss and retry are not yet handled.
「开始」时发送一帧标准格式数据帧。按协议驱动总线，标出仲裁段、应答位和帧结束末位: On Start, send one standard-format data frame. Drive the bus and mark arbitration, ACK and the last end-of-frame bit; take each queued byte when its last original bit is accepted, and give yes on Done on the final intermission bit. Say 1 while idle.
发送一帧；缺应答时发六位显性错误标志，重置队列，等待八位错误界定段及三位帧间隔后: Send a frame. On a missing ACK, send a six-bit dominant error flag, rewind the queue, and retry after the eight-bit error delimiter and three-bit intermission. Output each attempt, completion, and the transmit error count. After successful transmission through the final end-of-frame bit, decrease the count by one to a minimum of zero.
先按「准备事件」更新错误计数，再发送一帧。总线上没有其他故障：缺应答时输出被动错: First update the error count from Preparation events, then send a frame. No other errors occur on the bus: on a missing ACK, send a passive error flag, reread the queue, and retry after the error delimiter, intermission and suspend transmission. Output every start, byte taken, queue rewind, completion, count and state; record a successful transmission on the final end-of-frame bit.
发送错误计数达到 256 时，节点下线，不能影响总线。要允许恢复，它必须先观察到: When the transmit error count reaches 256, the node goes bus-off and cannot affect the bus. Before it may recover, it must observe 128 groups of eleven consecutive recessive bits; groups may be separated by dominant bits.
下线时逐拍观察输入位。每数到十一位连续的 1，完整组数加一并从零继续；显性 0: While bus-off, observe each input bit. For every eleven consecutive 1s increment the completed group count and restart the run; a dominant 0 clears an incomplete run but preserves completed groups. At 128, retain the count and answer yes. Clear all progress when Bus-off is 0.
一张寄存卡数当前连续的隐性位，另一张记完整组数。每完成一组，第一张从零重新数。: Use one register to count the current recessive run and another for completed groups. Restart the first after every completed group.
满足观察条件后节点才可以恢复；具体控制器还可能要求软件请求。恢复时错误计数清零。: The node may recover only after observing the required groups; a particular controller may also require a software request. Recovery resets its error counters.
下线时观察 128 组互不重叠的十一位隐性；显性清除未完成的一组，下线输入为 0: While bus-off, observes 128 non-overlapping groups of eleven recessive bits; a dominant bit clears the incomplete group and Bus-off 0 clears all progress.
观察条件满足后，控制器还可能需要软件明确请求恢复。本练习把请求与已完成的观察条件: After the observation condition is met, a controller may also need an explicit software recovery request. This exercise combines the request with the completed observation.
只在下线期间已经观察到 128 组十一位隐性，且本拍收到恢复请求时，交出「是」；: Answer yes only on a recovery request when 128 groups of eleven recessive bits have been observed while bus-off; otherwise answer no. Progress clears when Bus-off is 0.
使用下线恢复观察元件，把它的允许恢复与请求组合。: Use the bus-off recovery observation component and combine its permission with the request.
允许复位后，还要重置错误计数，并回到主动状态；本关只判断请求是否被允许。: Once reset is allowed, error counts must also be reset and the node returned to the active state. This exercise only decides whether the request is permitted.
恢复条件和请求都满足后，节点才能重置两个错误计数并回到主动状态。为了让每拍的先后: Once both the observation condition and the request are satisfied, the node may reset its error counters and return to the active state. To make tick order explicit, this exercise resets on the tick after accepting the request.
按事件更新发送计数、接收计数和状态。下线后从下一拍开始观察输入位；累计 128: Update transmit count, receive count and state from events. Starting on the tick after bus-off, observe the input bit. After 128 groups of eleven recessive bits, accept a recovery request and reset both counters and return active on the next tick. Initialize starts the exercise.
把上一拍的状态接给下线恢复观察元件；请求获准后用寄存卡保存，下一拍复位错误计数元: Connect the previous tick’s state to the bus-off recovery observer. Store an accepted request in a register and reset the fault counter on the next tick.
下线时仍可监听总线，但不能影响总线。恢复条件、软件请求和计数清零需要按顺序连接。: A bus-off node can still listen but cannot affect the bus. Connect the recovery condition, software request and counter reset in order.
输了再发，没应答再发: Retry after arbitration and missing ACK
控制器可能先在仲裁中落败，听完并应答赢家，再发送自己的帧；重发时也可能等不到应答: A controller may first lose arbitration, receive and acknowledge the winner, and then send its own frame; that retry may also go unacknowledged. Now connect these two different waits.
从开始拍发送数据帧。仲裁落败时停止发送、接收并应答正确的赢家帧，在帧间隔后重试；: Send a data frame on Start. If arbitration is lost, stop sending, receive and acknowledge a correct winning frame, and retry after intermission. If your frame is not acknowledged, send an active error flag, rewind the queue and retry after the error delimiter and intermission. Give loss, each attempt, queue advances and rewind, completion and the transmit error count. Tests have at most one initial contention, distinct identifiers, a correct winning frame and a small number of missing ACKs.
复用仲裁器和校验抓帧器。赢家 CRC 正确时记下应答，下一拍拉低总线。: Reuse the arbiter and checked frame capture. When the winner’s CRC is correct, remember to acknowledge and pull the bus dominant on the next tick.
用不同状态区分接收赢家与发送错误标志；两种情况都等总线连续 11 位隐性后重新发: Use separate states for receiving the winner and sending an error flag. In either case, retry after eleven consecutive recessive bus bits. Only missing ACK rewinds the already consumed queue.
仲裁落败不是错误：它不增加发送错误计数。缺应答会中断当前帧并记账，队列必须从头重: Losing arbitration is not an error and does not increase the transmit error count. Missing ACK interrupts the frame and updates the count, and the queue must be read again. This exercise does not yet cover bit errors, passive nodes or another frame arriving during the wait.
发送过程中，除了缺应答，发送方也可能在仲裁段以外发现自己说的位和总线实际位不同。: Besides a missing ACK, a sender may find outside arbitration that the bit it said differs from the actual bus. A bit error also interrupts the frame, and bytes already taken must be sent again.
连接仲裁、接收应答、位错误与缺应答恢复。仲裁段的显性覆盖是正常落败，应答位的显性: Connect arbitration, receiving and acknowledging, bit errors and missing-ACK recovery. Dominant overriding recessive during arbitration is normal loss, and dominant in the ACK slot is a normal acknowledgement. A mismatch on another transmitted bit, or a recessive ACK slot, reports an error, sends an active error flag and retries the entire frame. Tests have one initial contention at most, at most one flipped bit, a small number of missing ACKs and an error-active sender.
先排除仲裁段和应答位，再比较发送位与采样位；只在自己仍在发送时检查。: Exclude arbitration and ACK before comparing the transmitted bit with the sampled bit; check only while your node is transmitting.
两种发送错误都重置队列和等待状态。错误计数区分一般发送错误与缺应答事件。: Both transmit errors rewind the queue and restart the wait. The fault counter distinguishes ordinary transmit errors from missing ACK events.
数据中途出错时，队列可能已经取走了部分字节；重发要从第一个字节开始。这里还没有合: A fault midway through data can occur after part of the queue has been consumed; retry must start from the first byte. This exercise does not yet combine passive state, bus-off or receive errors.
两个发送方使用同一个标识符时，仲裁字段完全相同，谁也不会退出。如果后面的数据不同: When two transmitters use the same identifier, their arbitration fields match and neither withdraws. If their data differs, dominant overrides recessive and a transmitter can detect a bit error in the data field.
两个节点同时发送相同标识符、长度相同但内容不同的数据帧。检查仲裁段和应答位以外的: Two nodes simultaneously send data frames with the same identifier and length but different payloads. Check transmitted bits outside arbitration and the ACK slot: if what you say differs from what you hear, send an active error flag and eight-bit delimiter starting next tick. Output error state and completion; the other sender also detects bit errors on the actual bus and sends a flag.
复用位错误检测与错误标志。仲裁不能按数据字段决定赢家；看到不同的数据要按发送错误: Reuse bit-error detection and the error flag. Arbitration cannot choose a winner from the data field; treat differing data as a transmit error.
同一个标识符不能靠仲裁区分两个不同的数据源。先发现位错误的一方开始发送错误标志，: Arbitration cannot distinguish different data sources with the same identifier. The first sender to detect a bit error starts an error flag; the other may detect one later, and their flags overlap on the bus. This exercise does not simulate retry.
把发送错误的处理接到错误状态上：主动节点用显性错误标志，被动节点用隐性标志，并在: Connect transmit-error handling to fault state: active nodes send dominant error flags, while passive nodes send recessive flags and wait eight additional bits after intermission. The error that makes a node passive still sends an active flag.
先按准备事件更新发送计数，再发送数据帧。处理初次仲裁、位错误和缺应答；按错误发生: First update the transmit count from preparation events, then send a data frame. Handle initial arbitration, bit errors and missing ACK. Choose the flag from the state before the error and decide the extra eight-bit wait from the state after error handling. A missing ACK does not increase the count when a passive flag sees no dominant bit. Output each attempt, queue operations, transmit error, count and state. Tests do not enter bus-off or add another frame during the wait.
用寄存卡保存错误发生前的状态，确保跨过 128 的那一次仍发主动标志。: Use a register to remember the state before the error, so the error that crosses 128 still sends an active flag.
错误标志完成后数三个帧间隔位，再把错误处理后的状态接到发送暂停元件；每次错误都要: After the error flag finishes, count three intermission bits and connect the resulting state to suspend transmission; restart the wait for every error.
错误发生前后的状态各有作用：前者决定本次错误标志，后者决定重发前是否需要发送暂停: The state before an error determines its flag; the state after it determines whether the next attempt needs suspend transmission. After ACK and the end-of-frame field, decrement the transmit count.
下线之后，再回总线: Return to the bus after bus-off
错误计数继续上升到 256 时，节点下线，不再驱动总线。它必须观察完 128 组: When the transmit error count reaches 256, the node goes bus-off and no longer drives the bus. It must observe 128 groups of eleven recessive bits and receive a recovery request before clearing its counters and retrying the pending frame.
先按准备事件更新计数，再发送一帧。处理主动与被动发送错误；若节点下线，停止驱动并: First update the count from preparation events, then send a frame. Handle active and passive transmit errors; if the node goes bus-off, release and observe the bus, accepting a request only after the recovery condition is met. On the next tick clear the count and retry the original frame. During bus-off the tests keep the bus recessive and do not simulate other nodes’ frames.
用上一拍状态判断是否下线，将总线和下线状态接入下线恢复观察元件。: Use the previous tick’s state to determine bus-off and connect the bus and that state to the bus-off recovery observer.
把观察完成与恢复请求组合后存入寄存卡；下一拍同时复位错误计数和重新开始发送。: Store the combination of completed observation and recovery request in a register. On the next tick both reset the fault counter and restart transmission.
下线节点不能继续尝试发送。完整的观察条件和恢复请求都满足后，才清零计数并让等待中: A bus-off node cannot keep transmitting. Only once both the observation condition and the recovery request are satisfied does it clear the count and retry the pending frame.
在连续总线上读帧的标识符、长度和数据字节；结果就绪时输出 0 正确、1 填充错误: Reads each frame’s identifier, length and data bytes on a continuous bus; when a result is ready, outputs 0 for valid, 1 for a stuff error or 2 for a CRC error, along with whether the frame matches. Errors here do not change the length field.
持续读取总线，交出每帧的标识符、长度和数据字节。发现填充错误时立即交出「否」和种: Read the continuous bus and give each frame’s identifier, length and data bytes. On a stuffing error immediately give no and kind 1; otherwise give the CRC result on the CRC delimiter, with kind 0 for valid or 2 for a CRC error. Give 「—」 on other ticks for each output.
收到完整帧后，正确的接收方在应答位拉低总线。填充错误要在下一拍报告；CRC 错误: After receiving a valid frame, a receiver pulls the ACK slot dominant. A stuff error is reported on the next tick; a CRC error waits until after the ACK delimiter before sending an error flag.
校验抓帧器交出结果种类：0 正确、1 填充错误、2 CRC 错误。用寄存卡把正确: The checked frame capture gives result kind: 0 valid, 1 stuff error, 2 CRC error. Delay a valid result by one tick with a register to drive the ACK slot.
填充错误立即触发错误标志；CRC 错误先延迟两拍，再触发标志。接收成功在应答拍记: Trigger an error flag immediately for a stuff error; delay a CRC error by two ticks before triggering the flag. Record successful reception on the ACK tick.
填充错误立即报告，CRC 错误等待应答界定位结束；正确接收时应答并降低接收错误计: A stuff error is reported immediately; a CRC error waits until the ACK delimiter ends. A correct reception is acknowledged and reduces the receive error count. Overlapping error flags and passive receivers are outside this exercise.
把接收与应答封装起来后，可以让另一块板只在检测到接收错误的那一拍发出提醒。: Once receive and acknowledge is packed as a component, another board can signal precisely the tick on which a receive error is detected.
在结果就绪时检查种类是否为 1 或 2；正确的种类 0 不应触发提醒。: When a result is ready, check whether its kind is 1 or 2; valid kind 0 must not trigger the signal.
结果种类让后续电路区分正确帧、填充错误和 CRC 错误；应答和错误标志仍由接收元: The result kind lets later circuits distinguish a correct frame, a stuff error and a CRC error; the receive component still sends ACK and error flags on time.
使用接收与应答元件驱动总线并维护接收计数，同时交出计数事件；填充错误或 CRC: Use the receive-and-acknowledge component to drive the bus, maintain the receive count and output the counter event; give yes on the tick a stuff or CRC error is detected and no on other ticks.
读取总线，正确接收时应答并标出应答拍，填充或 CRC 错误按各自时序发主动标志；: Reads the bus, acknowledges correct frames and marks the ACK tick, and sends active flags at the appropriate time for stuff and CRC errors; outputs counter events and updates the receive error count. Limited to one frame and no overlapping errors.
接收一帧：正确时在应答位说 0；填充错误时从下一拍发主动错误标志，CRC 错误时: Receive one frame: say 0 in the ACK slot if valid; after a stuff error send an active flag from the next tick, and after a CRC error send it following the ACK delimiter. Output result kind, result ready, ACK tick, counter event and receive error count. Preparation events supply receive errors before the frame; decrement the count on successful acknowledgement and increment it on error. Tests contain one frame, one error-active receiver and at most one flipped data or CRC bit.
接收方处于被动错误状态时，仍要应答正确的帧；发现错误时发送隐性错误标志。使节点从: A receiver in error-passive state still acknowledges a correct frame, but sends a recessive error flag when it detects an error. The error that changes a node from active to passive still uses an active flag.
接收并应答正确帧；发现填充或 CRC 错误时，按错误发生前的状态选择主动或被动标: Receive and acknowledge valid frames. On a stuff or CRC error, select an active or passive flag according to the state before the error. State input 0 is active and 1 is passive; it may change after error detection. Output the result, ACK tick, counter event and receive count. Tests do not enter bus-off or simulate overlapping error flags.
记住错误发生时的状态，用它控制整个错误标志；应答拍要单独保留，不能把被动错误标志: Remember the state when the error is detected and use it for the whole flag. Preserve ACK separately: the rule for a passive error flag does not apply to acknowledgements.
被动接收方仍可应答正确帧，只是错误标志不再拉低总线。标志类型由发现错误时的状态决: A passive receiver still acknowledges correct frames; only its error flag no longer pulls the bus dominant. The state when the error is detected determines the flag type.
复用接收与应答元件，按错误发生前的主动或被动状态选择错误标志，同时保留正确帧的显: Reuses receive and acknowledge, choosing error flags from the active or passive state before the error while retaining dominant acknowledgements for valid frames.
现在把接收结果和错误状态结合起来，交出错误发生的那一拍，同时保留节点的应答与标志: Now combine receive results and error state to signal the tick an error occurs while retaining the node’s ACK and flag timing.
使用状态化接收元件；填充错误或 CRC 错误出现的那一拍交出「是」，其余拍交出「: Use the state-aware receiver; give yes on the tick a stuff or CRC error appears and no otherwise. Also drive the bus and output the counter event.
结果就绪时，种类 1 或 2 表示接收错误；状态化接收元件负责选择标志并保留正确: When a result is ready, kind 1 or 2 means a receive error; the state-aware receiver chooses the flag and retains valid ACKs.
接收错误事件可以送到统一的错误计数器；错误标志与应答的时序仍由接收电路负责。: Receive error events can feed a shared fault counter; the receive circuit remains responsible for the timing of ACK and error flags.
节点的主动或被动状态同时取决于发送和接收错误计数。现在把接收电路的计数事件交给统: A node’s active or passive state depends on both transmit and receive error counts. Connect receive counter events to the shared fault counter, then use the resulting state to select receive error flags.
准备事件可包含发送错误 1 或接收错误 3。接收一帧，交出两个计数、状态、接收结: Preparation events may include transmit error 1 or receive error 3. Receive one frame and output both counts, state, receive result and counter event; acknowledge a valid frame, and choose an error flag from the state before an error. Tests do not enter bus-off and have no overlapping errors.
把接收电路的计数事件接到错误计数元件，用寄存卡保存上一拍状态，再送回状态化接收元: Connect the receive circuit’s counter event to the fault counter; save the previous tick’s state in a register and feed it to the state-aware receiver.
发送计数或接收计数达到 128 都会使节点进入被动状态；导致转换的接收错误仍发主: Either transmit or receive count reaching 128 makes a node passive; the receive error causing that transition still sends an active flag.
将状态化接收与统一错误计数连接；根据发送和接收计数选择接收错误标志，正确接收时应: Connects state-aware reception to shared error counts; selects receive flags from transmit and receive counts and acknowledges correct frames. Limited to one frame, no bus-off and no overlapping errors.
把接收与统一计数封装后，另一块板可以观察接收错误，同时保留当前状态和总线行为。: Once reception and the shared counter are packed together, another board can observe receive errors while retaining the state and bus behavior.
使用统一状态接收元件；交出状态和计数事件，在填充或 CRC 错误出现的那一拍交出: Use the shared-state receiver; give the state and counter event, and give yes on the tick a stuff or CRC error appears and no otherwise. Drive the bus according to the component’s acknowledgement and error flag.
结果就绪时，种类 1 或 2 是错误；状态和总线驱动直接取自统一状态接收元件。: When a result is ready, kind 1 or 2 is an error; take state and bus drive from the shared-state receiver.
统一计数状态可供收发两侧共用；本练习仍只接入了接收侧。: The shared counter state can serve both transmission and reception; this exercise connects reception only.
现在把同一节点的接收和发送接在一起。接收帧改变的错误状态必须保留下来，影响随后的: Connect reception and transmission on the same node. The fault state changed by a received frame must carry over to later transmission; while sending, the node must not acknowledge its own frame as if it came from another sender.
先接收一帧并按状态应答或报告接收错误；随后在开始拍发送队列中的一帧，处理位错误和: First receive a frame and acknowledge it or report its receive error according to state; then send the queued frame on Start, handling bit errors and missing-ACK retries. Sending and receiving share one fault counter and state; while transmitting, do not feed your own bits to the receiver. Tests are receive-then-send, without simultaneous arbitration, new frames during waits or bus-off.
把接收电路的计数事件和发送事件接到同一个错误计数器；发送事件发生时优先处理发送事: Connect receive counter events and transmit events to the same fault counter, giving transmit events priority when they occur.
开始发送的当拍就屏蔽接收输入，直到自己的帧和间隔完成；空闲时让接收电路驱动应答及: Mask the receiver input on the tick transmission starts and until the node’s frame and intermission finish; while idle, let the receive circuit drive ACK and error flags.
接收错误可能让节点进入被动状态，改变下一次发送的错误标志和等待。屏蔽自发帧避免节: A receive error can make the node passive, changing the flag and delay on its next transmission. Masking the node’s own frame prevents it acknowledging itself. This exercise does not yet cover simultaneous receive/transmit contention or another frame arriving while waiting.
发送时可能有另一个节点同时开口。接收器必须从帧起始就跟踪总线：一旦自己仲裁落败，: Another node may start at the same time as your transmission. The receiver must follow the bus from start of frame so that, if your node loses arbitration, it can continue receiving and acknowledge the winner.
先接收一帧，再与另一个节点同时尝试发送。若落败，接收并应答赢家、更新接收计数，帧: First receive one frame, then attempt transmission simultaneously with another node. If you lose, receive and acknowledge the winner, update the receive count and retry after intermission; if you win, do not acknowledge your own frame. Continue handling bit errors and missing ACKs with shared counts. Tests have one initial contention, distinct identifiers, a correct winner, no new frame while waiting and no bus-off.
接收器持续跟踪总线；只有空闲接收或仲裁落败时才转交它的事件与驱动。: Keep the receiver following the bus; forward its events and drive only when receiving while idle or after arbitration loss.
重发开始的当拍先选择自己的发送位，即使上一拍仍在接收赢家；正确接收赢家时，接收计: On the tick retry starts, choose your own transmitted bit even if you were still receiving the winner on the previous tick. A valid winning frame updates the receive count in its ACK slot.
提前跟踪帧起始使落败节点能够完整接收赢家。若自己获胜，同一接收器的结果必须被屏蔽: Following the start of frame lets a losing node receive the complete winner. If the node wins, the same receiver’s results must be suppressed to prevent self-ACK and incorrect accounting.
